{"text":"Hello {first_name},

This is {clinic_name}. We sent you a note before about a follow-up visit. We want to make sure you saw it.

We would love to see you. Please book your visit by {due_by}. Call us at {clinic_phone} and we will help you find a time.

We look forward to hearing from you.

If you do not want these reminders, you can stop them here: {opt_out_link}"}
